$comment: Machine-readable record of where this fork was cut from. Read by scripts/check_upstream_boundary.py. The base is upstream's own release tag, and this repository carries upstream's full history up to it, so `git merge-base HEAD upstream/main` resolves and upstream syncs are ordinary three-way merges (see UPSTREAM.md).
proprietaryReason: Upstream's NOTICE, docs/brand/LICENSE-brand.txt and assets/app-icon/LICENSE.txt state that the ArtCraft name, wordmark, logo and "A" mark (including the app icon rendered from it) are trademarks of the ArtCraft Team, not covered by MIT OR Apache-2.0, and that forks and modified versions must remove them. Until proprietaryReplaced is true the check reports how many of these files are still byte-identical to upstream; once true, it fails if any is.
